description: Defines the ColumnRange class for handling ranges of spreadsheet columns, including methods for shifting, converting, and representing column ranges, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: ColumnRange
classes.description: Represents a range of columns in a spreadsheet, with methods for manipulation and conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ColumnRange with start and end columns, optionally associated with a worksheet.

methods.name: fromColumnIndexes
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from numeric column indexes.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ColumnRange from an array of column identifiers.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Ensures the from and to indexes are in correct order.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the range.

methods.name: shiftDown
methods.description: Shifts the column range downward by an offset.

methods.name: shiftUp
methods.description: Shifts the column range upward by an offset.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting column as a string.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending column as a string.

methods.name: toCellRange
methods.description: Converts the column range to a CellRange object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the column range, including worksheet title if available.
